entities.summary: Addai Scher Also written Addai Sher, Addaï Scher and Addai Sheir, an ethnic Assyrian, was the Chaldean Catholic archbishop of Siirt in Upper Mesopotamia. He was killed by the Ottomans during the 1915 Assyrian Genocide.
